title: Decoction, infusion and hydroalcoholic extract of Origanum vulgare L.: different performances regarding bioactivity and phenolic compounds
summary: Compared the three preparations for antioxidant and antibacterial activity and phenolic compounds. The abstract reports activity against Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria; the hydroalcoholic extract showed the strongest activity against E. coli.
limitation: Laboratory assays, not a human treatment study. The study preparation and plant material are not established as identical to the Sharr Mountains record.
